title: Trivial Pursuit Party
description: A multiplayer party trivia game for adults ages 57-70 featuring six nostalgic categories. First player to collect all six category wedges wins.
learningObjective: Players answer nostalgic trivia questions across six categories and track category wedges during a live party game.
